DungeonTileset II v1.7
Author: Robert (0x72), with recolor help credited by the author to GrafxKid
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Source page: https://0x72.itch.io/dungeontileset-ii

Files in this folder are the unmodified v1.7 sheet, the low-wall autotile atlas,
the author's frame list, and the autotile README shipped with that release.
Living Dungeon slices and recolors copies under art/. The game does not load
this folder at runtime.
